note: Knight, front view, sword in the left (image-left) hand and a round shield on the right arm. Head is the helmet, hair, ears and beard, bottom y~468 at the beard tip; gorget, plate cuirass, belt, tassets, the red cape, and the brown scabbard/strap hanging down-left from the belt (a worn item, torso) are torso. Left arm: pauldron upper arm to y~550 where the dark vambrace begins, forearm to y~598, then the armoured gauntlet fist y596-655 (hand). The drawn sword is equipment: the wide blade from its tip at (172,452) down to the guard end near (320,675), kept off the gauntlet; the brown piece below the blade is NOT the grip (it points away down-left) so it is labelled torso. The right arm is hidden behind the round shield except the pauldron on top: only the upper arm (y452-545) is labelled and the shield (x628-782, y515-762) is equipment. Hip is the lower edge of the tasset plates y~745; cuisses are thigh down to the knee cops, whose top edge is the knee (y~787 left, y~788 right); greaves are lower leg, ankles at the sabaton instep (y872).
